title: Prepositions
subtitle: à, de, en, dans, sur, sous, avec, pour, sans, chez. Contractions: à + le = au; à + les = aux; de + le = du; de + les = des.
objectives: Apply the concepts in reading and writing.

sections.heading: Main content
sections.body: French prepositions govern nouns and pronouns. The prepositions à and de contract with the definite article: à + le = au, à + les = aux, de + le = du, de + les = des. No contraction with la or l'.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you can apply the concepts without hesitation.
